تقتحمي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَحِمِي (taqtaḥimī) /taq.ta.ħi.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# تُقْتَحَمِي (tuqtaḥamī) /tuq.ta.ħa.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
